# megam_api

**Tag**: web, cli, networking

## 简介

Ruby Client for the Megam vertice. Performs REST calls to Vertice Gateway -  http://github.com/megamsys/vertice_gateway.git

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/megamsys/megam_api
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/megam_api/1.52.6
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/megam_api
